name: Sinja UnityStory
detailed_description:
ABOUT  this Game

After starting the game (currently), select 6 playable characters, then select 2 companion characters on the upper right.

For character manipulation, you can mainly use the right mouse drag and drop and wasd. The left mouse manipulation is only responsible for rotating the camera, so do not use it for the main character manipulation (movement, battle), etc.!

After that, through the portal & gate-like objects, you can go up to Stage 1 (Outdoor Park), Stage 2 (Indoor Research Institute), Stage 3 (Outdoor Military Base), and Stage 4 (Outdoor Core Facility). As the stages go up, the enemies get stronger, and you have to destroy the enemy buildings that exist in each stage to prevent the enemies from being produced periodically. Depending on the stage, there are various types of enemies (ground enemies, air enemies, underwater enemies, various buildings) and their behavior patterns are different.

Every time you destroy enemy buildings and enemies, the player's level increases, and as the level increases, the player's Power, Energy, and Defense increase, and stronger skills (level-based skills) can be used, and the two companion characters also become stronger and have diverse skills in proportion to the player.

Each player's characteristics, skills, and attack types are designed to be unique. Depending on the player, you can check the wand weapon (long-range attack) specialized character and sword weapon specialized character through the U key, and you can engage in strategic battles by wearing a weapon according to your specialized weapon type, and you can obtain a certain amount of gold and items through battles with enemies, and you can buy/sell these items at the store on the stage.

Until the player's level reaches 600, it may feel somewhat difficult to develop. You must manage the player's stamina well while engaging in battle. After level 600, all characters will be able to use powerful skills for the first time, making battles much easier.

When the level reaches 1000, the player, companion characters, and player spirit characters (spirit characters that symbolize each player's identity) will also become stronger, and the player will be able to fly, and their mobility and combat power will increase significantly. From level 1000 or higher, battles with airborne and underwater enemies will become easier, and the scale of battles will gradually increase. You can also battle underwater enemies by going underwater and changing to swimming mode.

For Stage 4 (Outdoor Core Military Facility: Urban), it is recommended to approach when you are at least level 1200, and through continued battles here, you can level up to a maximum level of 3000. If you play for about 80 to 90 minutes, you can reach close to level 2000.

Controls

Controls are supported only with the mouse and keyboard. You must equip the initial basic item in your inventory to be able to attack using the Ctrl key, and you can use basic attacks and skills at the attackable range point where the mouse cursor is located.

Requirements

SinjaUnityStory can work on any windows computer with working 3d graphics is sufficient. SinjaUnityStory was exported to support pc and it was tested in windows 10.

System Requirements

Minimum:

Operating System: Windows 10

Processor: i4

Memory: 8gb ram

Graphics: nVidia GT1030

Storage: 300mb available space

Sound Card: Realtek

Recommended:

Operating System: Windows 10

Processor: i5

Memory: 16gb ram

Graphics: nVidia GTX1050

Storage: 600mb available space

Sound Card: Realtek
